brief:
An Israeli drone strike killed one Palestinian and injured several others Saturday after targeting a civilian home in Deir al-Balah, a city in the central Gaza Strip, IMEMC News reported. The strike destroyed or damaged the residence and left multiple people wounded, though specific casualty figures were not immediately available.

In a separate incident the same day, a Palestinian child was shot with live ammunition in Beit Lahia, located in northern Gaza. Details on the child's condition were not provided.

title: Israeli drone strike kills Palestinian in central Gaza
